name: Reboot When Quiet
description: Reboots a machine that owes a reboot (a kernel fix takes effect only then) at the first moment nobody is busy on it: no one logged in, no one signed in and using its sites, no install, backup or long query under way. One machine at a time; one that does not come back stops the rest. A machine never quiet reboots in the nightly window (04:00-05:00 UTC) once it has owed one a day. Each machine's page can set it to the window only, or never.
